A New Beginning#000.src: So, want me to take you over?

A New Beginning#001.src: What do you do for the resistance?

A New Beginning#002.src: You youngsters *hic* always poke fun... think it's make-believe... But I promises ya! 'e's real!

A New Beginning#003.src: And I have to say: You look just like the kind of person that could take it on.

A New Beginning#004.src: Owners have been listed as unloyal to the crown. Have been disposed of.

A New Beginning#005.src: Another region? What do you mean?

A New Beginning#006.src: Uh... one second. Let me find them...

A New Beginning#007.src: Understood. Now, back to- where did they go?!

A New Beginning#008.src: New Chapter Started: Leaves in the Wind

A New Beginning#009.src: Um. The thing at T-Torann... you w-wouldn't happen to-... n-n-nevermind. I don't need to know!

A New Beginning#010.src: You'll need to search quickly, in case any guards return.

A New Beginning#011.src: The door is locked from the other side.

A New Beginning#012.src: Perhaps it's accessible from another location.

A New Beginning#013.src: This must be the records room... It's locked.

A New Beginning#014.src: "Only guards with appropriate clearance may access the records. If you believe a mistake has been made with your clearance level, inquire at the office."

A New Beginning#015.src: Wait, a suspicious person in the region- is this the cursed one?! Get them!!

A New Beginning#016.src: The Sovereign must be in the office with the key- that'd be in the other tower. You need to hurry before you're discovered.

A New Beginning#017.src: Sovereign, sir. It seems {p} was not prepared to directly face a cursed one. Dozens of soldiers are dead.

A New Beginning#018.src: I have a dozen and a half other problems to solve that need to be pushed back- oh, would you put away the key already?

A New Beginning#020.src: This must be the key that unlocks the record storage.

A New Beginning#023.src: Subject brought to {p} by the Driver. (Note: Interrogate Driver for reasoning.)

A New Beginning#024.src: Seems to originate from Wynn Province. Matches description of one Queen's Tournament participant.

A New Beginning#025.src: Do not engage without backup or blessed equipment. Subject is dangerous, and has shown no regard for military life.

A New Beginning#026.src: If sighted, report to superiors immediately. Keep an eye on subject, but do not engage. Keep them in sight until-

A New Beginning#027.src: You can't afford to be spotted. You need to take the records, and find a way out without alerting the guards.

A New Beginning#029.src: ...I th-thought you were m-making things up again.

A New Beginning#030.src: Excuse you? I don't make things up! You can ask Mora, he saw it too.

A New Beginning#031.src: If you s-say so... I just- I-I-I thought there were no p-people left out there. The c-crown keeps a whole g-garrison stationed to f-fight off... um... m-m-monsters.

A New Beginning#032.src: Wh- I d-don't know! It s-s-sounded believable to me!

A New Beginning#033.src: Ugh, whatever! I don't have time for this, Zeph, I have work to do. Just... stay on your guard. I don't trust whatever's going on with this stranger.

A New Beginning#034.src: How'd you know I needed help?

A New Beginning#035.src: The breeze carries the sounds of windchimes...

A New Beginning#036.src: So let's get to the business at hand. I'll start with this - you're from the Wynn Province, aren't you?

A New Beginning#037.src: You trust me enough to tell me that?

A New Beginning#038.src: Even if you chose to reveal my secrets - and if anyone even believed you - you'd have no guarantee of your own safety.

A New Beginning#039.src: Something strange is happening here. I can feel it.

A New Beginning#040.src: The power you carry - the curse you bear. I have seen such things before, yet always at a distance. Never up close.

A New Beginning#041.src: ...I have a different perspective on this story, you might imagine. The crown has wronged me, and many others. Yet, the stories hold truths to them, to some extent.

A New Beginning#042.src: I've only ever known it as magic. Where I'm from, most people can wield it.

A New Beginning#043.src: Then that leads me to my final request. Would you join our cause, and offer your help to our resistance group? Your knowledge and strength will be greatly appreciated.

A New Beginning#045.src: Um... wait, can I ask- actually... nevermind.

A New Beginning#046.src: Well, welcome to the Leaves in the Wind! Pardon the hesitation earlier, the cursed are a... sensitive subject. If Syndra believes you to be safe, I will choose to believe her.

A New Beginning#047.src: It's always nice to have some fresh blood under our canopy! No matter how abnormal. We may wait for Syndra's return before getting you properly settled in.

A New Beginning#048.src: If you have any issues whatsoever, don't hesitate to inform me!

A New Beginning#049.src: I am Syndra's right hand! I deal with many of the tasks involving our family here, to lighten the workload she places upon herself.

A New Beginning#050.src: Such tasks could include onboarding new recruits, assigning members to various missions... handling disputes- that sort of thing.

A New Beginning#051.src: Of course, my "official" occupation by the crown's terms is that of a lumberjack. Fighting for a better future isn't exactly a well paying job, hoho!

A New Beginning#052.src: I'm a tactician, otherwise. Not the tactician- that'd be Syndra- but... y'know.

A New Beginning#053.src: No, you didn't- ugh! It's not you personally, it's just...

A New Beginning#056.src: Yes... A toddler could calculate that by watching you. I'll solve that problem for you. Keep them out of trouble, and we won't have any issues- as usual.

A New Beginning#058.src: Simple - I don't. You don't need to worry about him. As I said, we have an agreement. He doesn't know about anything we do.

A New Beginning#059.src: You shouldn't get near a running saw that big! Find a way to disable it first.

A New Beginning#061.src: Halt! I'll need to see some form of identification.
A New Beginning#061.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#062.src: New policy, sorry for the inconvenience. We're heightening security around here.
A New Beginning#062.dst: 新规定，给你添麻烦了。我们正在加强这一带的戒备。
A New Beginning#062.speaker: Espren City Guard

A New Beginning#063.src: It shouldn't take too much of your time, don't worry! Just show us your citizen identification papers, and we'll let you on through.
A New Beginning#063.dst: 不会耽误你太久，别担心！只要把公民身份文件给我们看一下，就放你过去。
A New Beginning#063.speaker: Espren City Guard

A New Beginning#066.src: What's taking so long? It can't be that hard to find those. You should have them on your person at all times.
A New Beginning#066.dst: 怎么这么久？找个文件没那么难吧。那东西本来就该随身带着。
A New Beginning#066.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#067.src: It’s a very new restriction. There was some incident nearby. I’m not sure on the details, but-
A New Beginning#067.dst: 这是刚出的规定。附近出了点事。具体情况我也不太清楚，不过——
A New Beginning#067.speaker: Espren City Guard

A New Beginning#068.src: Enough stalling. Where are your papers?
A New Beginning#068.dst: 别拖时间了。你的文件呢？
A New Beginning#068.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#069.src: If you don’t present identification, I’m going to need to take you in for questioning.
A New Beginning#069.dst: 如果你拿不出身份证明，我就只能带你回去问话了。
A New Beginning#069.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#070.src: O-oh, hey, th-there you are! Gosh, I was w-wondering where you'd gotten off to!
A New Beginning#070.dst: 噢、噢，嘿，你、你在这儿！天哪，我还在想你跑、跑哪儿去了！

A New Beginning#071.src: Ha... d-don't tell me you forgot your papers again! I k-keep telling you to keep th-them with you...
A New Beginning#071.dst: 哈……别、别告诉我你又忘带文件了！我一、一直叫你随身带、带着……

A New Beginning#072.src: One of th-these days, you'll remember! F-for sure...
A New Beginning#072.dst: 总有一天你、你会记住的！肯、肯定会……

A New Beginning#073.src: You d-didn’t forget our conversation too, d-did you? S-s-sorry for my friend, sir!
A New Beginning#073.dst: 你没、没把我们刚才说的也忘了吧？抱、抱、抱歉，长官，我朋友就这样！

A New Beginning#074.src: Ahem. I'll still need to see identification if you want to enter the city.
A New Beginning#074.dst: 咳。想进城的话，我还是得看身份证明。
A New Beginning#074.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#075.src: Oh! O-o-of course! L-let me just...
A New Beginning#075.dst: 噢！当、当、当然！让、让我找一下……

A New Beginning#076.src: ...They're a-around here s-s-somewhere, I'm s-sure... I think they m-might be
A New Beginning#076.dst: ……应该就在这、这附近，我确、确、确定……我想可、可能在——

A New Beginning#077.src: Aha! Here! Identification p-papers, just for y-you!
A New Beginning#077.dst: 找到了！在这儿！身份文件，给、给您！

A New Beginning#078.src: ...What even is this? I can barely read the handwriting... Is that Sovereign Selium's signature? The previous sovereign?
A New Beginning#078.dst: ……这到底是什么？字迹我几乎认不出来……这是 Selium 统领的签名？前任统领？
A New Beginning#078.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#079.src: I've had enough of these games. The two of you are under
A New Beginning#079.dst: 我受够这种把戏了。你们两个现在因为——
A New Beginning#079.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#082.src: We've received more information about the incident at {p}. There's a new cursed one to look out for. Dozens of soldiers were killed in an attempt to capture them.
A New Beginning#082.dst: 我们收到了关于 {p} 那件事的更多情报。又出现了一个新的受诅者，要多加提防。为了抓住对方，已经死了几十个士兵。
A New Beginning#082.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#083.src: We're taking reinforcements to the fort, but I need you to remain at your posts. Keep a watchful eye on any suspicious individuals.
A New Beginning#083.dst: 我们要带援军去堡垒，但我需要你们留守岗位。留意任何可疑的人。
A New Beginning#083.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#084.src: ...Th-this might be a good time to run. While they're distracted! Quick, f-follow me!
A New Beginning#084.dst: ……现、现在大概是逃跑的好时机。趁他们分心！快，跟、跟我来！

A New Beginning#085.src: Understood. Now, back to where did they go?!
A New Beginning#085.dst: 明白。好，回到刚才——人去哪儿了？！
A New Beginning#085.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#087.src: Phew... G-glad we got out of there...
A New Beginning#087.dst: 呼……还、还好我们逃出来了……

A New Beginning#088.src: A-anyway. What were you th-thinking? Trying to enter the city without p-papers...
A New Beginning#088.dst: 总、总之。你在想什、什么啊？没有文、文件还想进城……

A New Beginning#089.src: You're n-new around here, right? Transferred in f-from elsewhere. Y-you're interesting, though.
A New Beginning#089.dst: 你是新、新来的吧？从别、别的地方调过来的。不、不过你挺有意思的。

A New Beginning#090.src: Um. The thing at T-Torann... you w-wouldn't happen to... n-n-nevermind. I don't need to know!
A New Beginning#090.dst: 呃。T、Torann 那件事……你该、该不会……算、算、算了。我不用知道！

A New Beginning#091.src: But, if y-you're interested... The military k-keeps records of these sorts of things! Th-they want a paper trail... or s-something.
A New Beginning#091.dst: 不过，如、如果你有兴趣……军队会、会把这类事情记录下来！他、他们要留个书面记录……之类的。

A New Beginning#092.src: You d-didn't hear this from me... but the l-leaves have whispered something about th-the location of a record storage. Here, hand me that b-book of yours...
A New Beginning#092.dst: 你没、没从我这儿听说过……不过树、树叶透露了一些关于记录存放处位置的消息。来，把你那本书给、给我……

A New Beginning#093.src: Well, good luck s-stranger! If anyone asks, we never m-met. But, um... y-you can call me Zeph.
A New Beginning#093.dst: 好啦，祝你好运，陌、陌生人！要是有人问起，我们从没见、见过。不过，呃……你、你可以叫我 Zeph。
A New Beginning#093.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#094.src: Find your report in the storage at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A New Beginning#094.dst: 在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的记录存放处找到你的报告。

A New Beginning#096.src: HALT! Intruder! For trespassing on restricted property, you are under
A New Beginning#096.dst: 站住！有人擅闯！你擅自闯入禁区，现在因为——
A New Beginning#096.speaker: Nixeph Watchman

A New Beginning#097.src: Wait, a suspicious person in the region is this the cursed one?! Get them!!
A New Beginning#097.dst: 等等，这一带有可疑人物——难道就是那个受诅者？！抓住他们！！
A New Beginning#097.speaker: Nixeph Watchman

A New Beginning#098.dst: 他们的目标是……Zhiraok 统领……别、别……你……你……
A New Beginning#098.speaker: Nixeph Watchman

A New Beginning#099.src: Well? You've crunched the numbers. Give me the report.
A New Beginning#099.dst: 怎么样？数字都算好了吧。把报告给我。
A New Beginning#099.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#100.src: Sovereign, sir. It seems {p} was not directly prepared to face a cursed one. Dozens of soldiers are dead.
A New Beginning#100.dst: 统领大人。看来 {p} 并没有做好直接面对受诅者的准备。几十个士兵阵亡了。
A New Beginning#100.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#101.src: ...of all the possibilities. How could that have factored out...? Hm. Who was the commanding officer? Their take on the problem would help fill the gaps.
A New Beginning#101.dst: ……偏偏是这种可能。这怎么会没算进去……？嗯。指挥官是谁？他对这个问题的看法能帮忙补上缺口。
A New Beginning#101.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#102.src: Well... it seems it was Commander Lilles, sir. But he was one of the casualties of the incident, and a replacement has yet to be promoted.
A New Beginning#102.dst: 这个……好像是 Lilles 指挥官，大人。但他也在这次事件中殉职了，接替的人选还没提拔。
A New Beginning#102.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#103.src: Naturally... I'll need to get hold of his family later and break the news. What else do you have on the Cursed One?
A New Beginning#103.dst: 果然……之后我得联系他的家人，把消息告诉他们。关于那个受诅者，你还掌握了什么？
A New Beginning#103.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#104.src: I've heard reports that they're... from outside. Possibly one of the ones who were invited into our province recently, though nobody seems certain on that.
A New Beginning#104.dst: 我听到的报告说，他们是……从外面来的。可能是最近受邀进入我们行省的那批人之一，不过似乎没人能确定。
A New Beginning#104.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#105.src: We've already raised security in {p}, and we have forces moving to Torann.
A New Beginning#105.dst: 我们已经加强了 {p} 的戒备，也有部队正在前往 Torann。
A New Beginning#105.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#106.src: One positive in a sea of negatives, I suppose. Good work. File the report in the records room, and then we'll go view the damages for ourselves.
A New Beginning#106.dst: 一片坏消息里总算有一个好消息。干得好。把报告送去资料室归档，然后我们亲自去看看损失。
A New Beginning#106.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#107.src: One more thing. Since Torann is compromised, we've taken the liberty of storing the cursed one's report here, so
A New Beginning#107.dst: 还有一件事。由于 Torann 已经失守，我们擅自把那个受诅者的报告存放在这里，所以——
A New Beginning#107.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#108.src: Do we not have a higher priority right now?!
A New Beginning#108.dst: 我们现在难道没有更要紧的事吗？！
A New Beginning#108.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#109.src: ...N-n-no, sir. My- my apologies. I simply thought
A New Beginning#109.dst: ……没、没、没有，大人。是、是我失礼了。我只是以为——
A New Beginning#109.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#110.src: I have a dozen and a half other problems to solve that need to be pushed back oh, would you put away the key already?
A New Beginning#110.dst: 我还有十几个别的问题等着解决，全都得往后推——噢，你能不能先把钥匙收起来？
A New Beginning#110.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#111.src: We haven't got time to sit around like this when there's a tragedy of that value to look into! We need to get to {p}, yesterday!
A New Beginning#111.dst: 出了那么大的惨剧要调查，我们没时间在这里干坐着！我们得马上赶去 {p}，一刻都不能等！
A New Beginning#111.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#112.src: Locate the key inside the eastern tower and retrieve your report.
A New Beginning#112.dst: 找到东边塔楼里的钥匙，取回你的报告。

A New Beginning#113.src: * Subject brought to {p} by the Driver. (Note: Interrogate Driver for reasoning.)
A New Beginning#113.dst: * 该对象由车夫带到 {p}。(注：审问车夫的动机。)
A New Beginning#113.speaker: "Unknown Cursed One"

A New Beginning#115.src: Someone's been here... search the outpost, quickly!
A New Beginning#115.dst: 有人来过这里……快，搜查前哨站！

A New Beginning#116.src: Find a way out of Nexiph Outpost.
A New Beginning#116.dst: 找出离开 Nixeph 前哨站的路。

A New Beginning#118.src: H-hey again, at the w-window! Tough s-situation, huh?
A New Beginning#118.dst: 嘿、嘿，又见面了，就在窗、窗边！处境很棘、棘手吧？
A New Beginning#118.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#119.src: I f-figured you could use a hand... Stand back a m-moment.
A New Beginning#119.dst: 我想、想你可能需要帮一把……往后站一、一下。
A New Beginning#119.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#121.src: I-I'll be down in a bit. Just h-hold on tight to the rope, and you'll be f-fine!
A New Beginning#121.dst: 我、我马上下来。抓紧绳子就行，你会没、没事的！
A New Beginning#121.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#122.src: Talk to Rex and Zeph at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A New Beginning#123.src: Phew! W-we got you out. G-good work back there, though!
A New Beginning#123.dst: 呼！我、我们把你救出来了。刚、刚才干得不错！
A New Beginning#123.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#125.src: D-don't mind her, she's just like that. Rex, this is
A New Beginning#125.dst: 别、别在意她，她就这样。Rex，这位是——
A New Beginning#125.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#126.src: The stranger you found trying to get into {p} without identification, I know. Do you really need me here still?
A New Beginning#126.dst: 就是你发现的那个没带身份证明想进 {p} 的陌生人，我知道。我真的还得待在这儿吗？
A New Beginning#126.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#127.src: ...I-I-I'd like it if you s-stayed, yes.
A New Beginning#127.dst: ……我、我、我希望你留、留下来，是的。
A New Beginning#127.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#129.src: Um... I- I don't think I c-c-caught your name.
A New Beginning#129.dst: 呃……我、我好像没、没、没听到你的名字。
A New Beginning#129.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#130.src: {u}... so, wh-where are you from? Y-you must've transferred in from an-another region, right?
A New Beginning#130.dst: {u}……那，你是从哪、哪里来的？你一定是从别、别的地区调过来的吧？
A New Beginning#130.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#131.src: Another... um... wh-what do you-... you d-don't know?
A New Beginning#131.dst: 别的……呃……你是什、什么意——……你不、不知道？
A New Beginning#131.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#132.src: Obviously they're not from here, Zeph! Remember that thing I told you about? The big spectacle event they had with people from beyond the gates?
A New Beginning#132.dst: Zeph，他们明显不是这里的人啊！还记得我跟你说过的那件事吗？他们搞的那场盛大活动，有从大门另一边来的人？
A New Beginning#132.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#133.src: You w-w-what?! But, there’s- th-that’s not possible...
A New Beginning#133.dst: 你、你、你说什么？！可是，那——那、那不可能……
A New Beginning#133.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#134.src: Possible or not, they’re obviously from outside the province! They’re probably involved with that big spectacle event with people from beyond the gates that I was telling you about.
A New Beginning#134.dst: 不管可不可能，他们显然是从行省外面来的！多半跟我跟你说过的那场有外面的人参加的盛大活动有关。
A New Beginning#134.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#135.src: …I th-thought you were m-making things up again.
A New Beginning#135.dst: ……我还、还以为你又在编故事了。
A New Beginning#135.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#136.src: Excuse you? I don’t make things up! You can ask Mora, he saw it too.
A New Beginning#136.dst: 你说什么？我才不编故事！不信你去问 Mora，他也看到了。
A New Beginning#136.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#137.src: If you s-say so… I just- I-I-I thought there were no p-people left out there. The c-crown keeps a whole g-garrison stationed to f-fight off… um… m-m-monsters.
A New Beginning#137.dst: 你说是就、就是吧……我只是——我、我、我一直以为外面已经没、没有人了。王、王室不是派了一整支驻、驻军在那边抵挡……呃……怪、怪、怪物嘛。
A New Beginning#137.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#139.src: Wh- I d-don’t know! It s-s-sounded believable to me!
A New Beginning#139.dst: 什——我、我不知道啊！我听、听、听着挺像真的！
A New Beginning#139.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#140.src: Ugh, whatever! I don’t have time for this. Zeph, I have work to do. Just… stay on your guard. I don’t trust whatever’s going on with this stranger.
A New Beginning#140.dst: 唉，随便啦！我没时间陪你们。Zeph，我还有事要做。你就……多提防点。这个陌生人身上的事，我一点都信不过。
A New Beginning#140.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#142.src: She's- um... she's n-not normally like this. S-sorry about that.
A New Beginning#142.dst: 她——呃……她平、平常不是这样的。抱、抱歉。
A New Beginning#142.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#143.src: O-Oh! I f-followed you, of course.
A New Beginning#143.dst: 噢、噢！我当、当然是跟着你来的。
A New Beginning#143.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#144.src: A s-stranger comes to our region without p-papers and is supposedly a c-cursed one? I wasn't letting you go th-that easily!
A New Beginning#144.dst: 一个没带文、文件的陌生人来到我们这一带，还可、可能是受诅者？我哪、哪可能就这样让你走！
A New Beginning#144.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#145.src: O-Oh! N-no problem! It was... it w-was nothing. Y-you did most of the work.
A New Beginning#145.dst: 噢、噢！不、不客气！那没……那没、没什么。大、大部分都是你自己做的。
A New Beginning#145.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#146.src: N-Nixeph is... n-not an easy place to break into! I g-guess all the guards were gone.
A New Beginning#146.dst: N、Nixeph 可……可不是那么好闯的地方！我猜、猜守卫都走光了。
A New Beginning#146.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#147.src: But, um... y-you got what you needed, and I got what I- what I needed, s-so...
A New Beginning#147.dst: 不过，呃……你拿到了你要的，我也拿到了我——我要的，所、所以……
A New Beginning#147.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#148.src: B-besides! I had s-something I needed to get from... f-from the outpost, anyway.
A New Beginning#148.dst: 再、再说！我本来就有东西要从……从前哨站拿出来。
A New Beginning#148.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#149.src: Um... th-there is someone you should meet. I was told to pass on a m-message...
A New Beginning#149.dst: 呃……有、有个人你应该见一见。有人托我转、转达一句话……
A New Beginning#149.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#150.src: And- and you'll be on y-your own this time. N-no help from me!
A New Beginning#150.dst: 而——而且这次你得靠自、自己了。我可不、不帮忙！
A New Beginning#150.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#151.src: The m-message is: w-westward, the giant lays its roots. As the wind blows, they s-sing along.
A New Beginning#151.dst: 那句话、话是：往、往西，巨人扎下根。风一吹，它们便跟、跟着歌唱。
A New Beginning#151.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#152.src: "Westward, the giant lays its roots. As the wind blows, they sing along."
A New Beginning#152.dst: “往西，巨人扎下根。风一吹，它们便跟着歌唱。”

A New Beginning#153.src: The m-message is: w-westward, the giant lays its roots. As the wind blows, they s-sing along.
A New Beginning#153.dst: 那句话、话是：往、往西，巨人扎下根。风一吹，它们便跟、跟着歌唱。
A New Beginning#153.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#154.src: Talk to the woman in the cave.

A New Beginning#155.src: Well, well. If it isn't a fresh breeze dancing in the leaves...
A New Beginning#155.dst: 哎呀哎呀。这不是在树叶间起舞的一阵清风吗……

A New Beginning#156.src: You must be the Cursed One who caused such a stir at Torann, yes? News has spread quickly of your actions.
A New Beginning#156.dst: 你就是在 Torann 闹出那么大动静的受诅者吧？你做的事已经传得很快了。

A New Beginning#157.src: I'm impressed you found your way to me.
A New Beginning#157.dst: 你能找到我这里，我很佩服。

A New Beginning#158.src: So let's get to the business at hand. I'll start with this you're from the Wynn Province, aren't you?
A New Beginning#158.dst: 那我们就说正事吧。先从这个开始——你是从 Wynn 行省来的，对吧？

A New Beginning#159.src: I thought so... You're certainly not from around here. Though, I would recommend you keep that information close to your chest.
A New Beginning#159.dst: 果然……你肯定不是本地人。不过，我建议你把这件事藏在心里。

A New Beginning#160.src: Very few people have knowledge of the outside world, and those that do... they're the ones who will be looking for you. Best to avoid drawing their attention.
A New Beginning#160.dst: 知道外面世界的人少之又少，而知道的那些人……正是会来找你的人。最好别引起他们的注意。

A New Beginning#161.src: But I should introduce myself. My name is Syndra, leader of the Leaves in the Wind resistance group.
A New Beginning#161.dst: 不过我该先自我介绍。我叫 Syndra，是抵抗组织“风中之叶”的首领。
A New Beginning#161.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#162.src: Call it something of a gamble. Given your... shall we say, explosive entrance into the province, I find it unlikely you're with the crown.
A New Beginning#162.dst: 就当是赌一把吧。以你……这么说吧，这么轰动地进入行省的方式来看，我不太相信你是王室那边的人。
A New Beginning#162.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#163.src: Even if you chose to reveal my secrets and if anyone even believed you you'd have no guarantee of your own safety.
A New Beginning#163.dst: 就算你把我的秘密说出去——而且就算真有人信你——你也无法保证自己的安全。
A New Beginning#163.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#164.src: Yes. You haven’t been here long, but you’ve felt it, haven’t you? The crown has its roots buried deep in this province, and it certainly isn’t kind to all.
A New Beginning#164.dst: 是的。你来这里还不久，但你已经感觉到了，对吧？王室在这个行省扎根很深，而它绝不是对所有人都仁慈。
A New Beginning#164.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#165.src: Those it sees as disposable… they don’t often make it far. That is why I have taken my role. I’d like to see a day where none are left behind.
A New Beginning#165.dst: 那些被它视为可以舍弃的人……往往走不了多远。所以我才担起这个角色。我希望有一天，没有任何人会被抛下。
A New Beginning#165.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#166.src: But that's enough about me. On to you. Why are you here, cursed one? For what purpose have you come to Fruma?
A New Beginning#166.dst: 我的事就说到这里。说说你吧。受诅者，你为什么在这里？你来 Fruma 是为了什么？
A New Beginning#166.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#167.src: Interesting. A sense that something isn't right...
A New Beginning#167.dst: 有意思。觉得有什么地方不对劲……
A New Beginning#167.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#168.src: To tell you the truth, it's one I've had myself for quite some time. Though, likely for a different reason to you.
A New Beginning#168.dst: 说实话，我自己也有这种感觉很久了。不过，理由大概跟你不一样。
A New Beginning#168.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#169.src: A noble cause… It is one I can wholeheartedly support.
A New Beginning#169.dst: 崇高的理由……我全心全意支持。
A New Beginning#169.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#170.src: In a world like this, the most we can do sometimes is hold on to those we care for. Take care not to lose that drive.
A New Beginning#170.dst: 在这样的世界里，有时我们能做的，最多就是守住自己在乎的人。别丢了这份动力。
A New Beginning#170.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#171.src: Then, I would ask of you one more thing. A test, in a way...
A New Beginning#171.dst: 那么，我还想请你做一件事。某种意义上，算是一场考验……
A New Beginning#171.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#172.src: The power you carry the curse you bear. I have seen such things before, yet always at a distance. Never up close.
A New Beginning#172.dst: 你身上的力量——你背负的诅咒。我以前见过这种东西，但一直是远远地看。从没这么近过。
A New Beginning#172.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#173.src: I would ask for a duel. Nothing dangerous, or lethal... I have safeguards in place for myself, so do not test my limits. When I call it, we stop.
A New Beginning#173.dst: 我想跟你决斗一场。不危险，也不致命……我这边有保命的手段，所以别去试探我的极限。我喊停，我们就停。
A New Beginning#173.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#174.src: I would simply like to see the strength of a cursed one in battle firsthand. So, then. Let us begin!
A New Beginning#174.dst: 我只是想亲眼看看受诅者在战斗中的实力。那么，开始吧！
A New Beginning#174.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#177.src: Impressive. Very impressive. I have never seen a cursed one with such control and technique...
A New Beginning#177.dst: 厉害。非常厉害。我从没见过哪个受诅者有这样的控制力和技巧……
A New Beginning#177.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#178.src: If I did not know better, I would believe you to have been blessed by the crown itself.
A New Beginning#178.dst: 要不是我清楚内情，我会以为你受过王室本身的祝福。
A New Beginning#178.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#179.src: Your power, your spells. The ability to bend the world to your whim, to wield the elements for your own gain.
A New Beginning#179.dst: 你的力量，你的法术。随心所欲地改变世界，驾驭元素为己所用的能力。
A New Beginning#179.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#180.src: Eons ago, so the stories say, the world was pure and balanced. Our people lived with the land, content with what we had.
A New Beginning#180.dst: 传说在很久很久以前，世界纯净而平衡。我们的人民与大地共存，满足于自己拥有的一切。
A New Beginning#180.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#181.src: And yet, an evil force lurked within us, a malice which despised our peace and happiness. One day, it burst forth, granting unimaginable power to those it deemed worthy...
A New Beginning#181.dst: 然而，我们内心潜伏着一股邪恶的力量，一种憎恶我们和平与幸福的恶意。有一天，它爆发出来，把难以想象的力量赐给了它认为配得上的人……
A New Beginning#181.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#182.src: Its power could not be controlled. Those cursed by its touch went on to tear apart the land, destroying cities and towns... fear overtook the land, none were safe.
A New Beginning#182.dst: 那股力量无法控制。被它触碰而受到诅咒的人开始撕裂大地，摧毁城市与村镇……恐惧笼罩了大地，无人幸免。
A New Beginning#182.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#183.src: Until she arrived, a force of good to counter the evil. She granted her own blessings to the people of Fruma, power which could be controlled and wielded to banish the cursed.
A New Beginning#183.dst: 直到她出现，一股对抗邪恶的善良力量。她把自己的祝福赐予 Fruma 的人民，那是能被控制、能被驾驭、用来驱逐受诅者的力量。
A New Beginning#183.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#184.src: She saved our province, and became our immortal Queen. Always looking out for the people, always alert for the presence of evil... for it could not be killed, only staved off.
A New Beginning#184.dst: 她拯救了我们的行省，成为我们永生的女王。她始终守护着人民，始终警惕着邪恶的存在……因为邪恶无法被杀死，只能被阻挡。
A New Beginning#184.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#185.src: The cursed ones never left. They only grew smarter, more capable of hiding from the crown's watchful eye.
A New Beginning#185.dst: 受诅者从未离开。他们只是变得更聪明，更懂得躲过王室的监视。
A New Beginning#185.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#186.src: And so, it tells the people, always be aware. Always be looking for the cursed ones. It is only a matter of time before they hurt you.
A New Beginning#186.dst: 所以，王室告诉人民，要时刻警惕。要时刻留意受诅者。他们迟早会伤害你。
A New Beginning#186.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#187.src: ...I have a different perspective on this story, you might imagine. The crown has wronged me, and many others. Yet, the stories hold truths to them, to an extent.
A New Beginning#187.dst: ……你大概想得到，我对这个故事有不同的看法。王室亏待了我，也亏待了许多人。不过，这些故事在某种程度上确实有真实的成分。
A New Beginning#187.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#188.src: That is why your control over your power has interested me. It bears more traits of the crown's blessings than of the evil's curses, and yet...
A New Beginning#188.dst: 所以你对自身力量的控制才引起我的兴趣。它更像王室的祝福，而不像邪恶的诅咒，然而……
A New Beginning#188.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#189.src: Magic... yes, that term has been used in higher studies at the University.
A New Beginning#189.dst: 魔法……是的，大学里的高等研究用过这个词。
A New Beginning#189.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#190.src: But a land filled with cursed ones... and it isn't destroyed? I suppose I have had no reason to believe the crown's reports about it, but...
A New Beginning#190.dst: 可是一片满是受诅者的土地……却没有毁灭？我想我本来就没理由相信王室关于那里的报告，但……
A New Beginning#190.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#191.src: I need time to process this information. But I would like to discuss it with you further, at a later date, if you would be willing.
A New Beginning#191.dst: 我需要时间消化这些信息。不过，如果你愿意，我想改天再跟你深入谈谈。
A New Beginning#191.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#192.src: Then that leads me to my final request. Would you join our cause, and offer your help to our resistance group? Your knowledge and strength would be greatly appreciated.
A New Beginning#192.dst: 那就说到我最后一个请求了。你愿意加入我们的事业，帮助我们的抵抗组织吗？你的知识和力量对我们会有很大的帮助。
A New Beginning#192.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#193.src: Thank you. I will take you to meet with the others, then. Our home is directly to the south-west, it should be hard to miss. I'll meet you there.
A New Beginning#193.dst: 谢谢你。那我带你去见其他人吧。我们的家就在西南方，应该很好找。我们在那里会合。
A New Beginning#193.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#194.src: Follow Syndra to the resistance base at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A New Beginning#195.src: There you are, {u}. I see you found your way here alright.
A New Beginning#195.dst: 你来了，{u}。看来你顺利找到这里了。
A New Beginning#195.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#196.src: If you're going to be joining us, I should introduce you to the others.
A New Beginning#196.dst: 既然你要加入我们，我该把你介绍给其他人。
A New Beginning#196.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#197.src: Ahem... Children, come on out! We have a new member I'd like you to meet.
A New Beginning#197.dst: 咳……孩子们，出来吧！有位新成员想让你们认识一下。
A New Beginning#197.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#198.src: We m-meet again! I knew you'd be a g-good fit!
A New Beginning#198.dst: 我、我们又见面了！我就知道你一、一定合适！
A New Beginning#198.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#199.src: Yeah, Zeph, we know. You've been saying so for hours...
A New Beginning#199.dst: 是啦，Zeph，我们知道。你已经念叨好几个小时了……
A New Beginning#199.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#200.src: Ah, lighten up Rex. Welcome to the Leaves, friend! No matter your origin, if Syndra believes you to be trustworthy, it must be so.
A New Beginning#200.dst: 哎，放轻松点，Rex。欢迎加入风中之叶，朋友！不管你从哪里来，只要 Syndra 认为你值得信任，那就一定没错。
A New Beginning#200.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#201.src: On that subject, {u} here is from outside of our province. They'll be joining our resistance against the crown...
A New Beginning#201.dst: 说到这个，这位 {u} 来自我们行省之外。他们会加入我们对抗王室……
A New Beginning#201.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#202.src: ...and, hopefully, they'll be able to help me resolve some theories I have on the nature of curses and blessings.
A New Beginning#202.dst: ……而且，希望他们能帮我解开我对诅咒与祝福本质的一些推测。
A New Beginning#202.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#204.src: Yes. But they're no threat to us. We share the same enemies. And, having that power on our side could make a huge difference for our efforts.
A New Beginning#204.dst: 是的。但他们对我们没有威胁。我们有共同的敌人。而且，有这份力量站在我们这边，会对我们的行动带来巨大的改变。
A New Beginning#204.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#205.src: Hm... are you certain, miss? I do trust your judgment, but perhaps it would be best to err on the side of caution when dealing with the cursed.
A New Beginning#205.dst: 嗯……您确定吗，女士？我当然相信您的判断，但面对受诅者，也许还是谨慎为上。
A New Beginning#205.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#206.src: The curse is the least of our problems! Are we really blindly trusting someone who says they're from Wynn? People don't just... just... come back from there!
A New Beginning#206.dst: 诅咒是我们最不用担心的！我们真的要盲目相信一个自称从 Wynn 来的人？人不可能就这样……就这样……从那里回来啊！
A New Beginning#206.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#207.src: That's enough, Rex. I understand your misgivings, but I have reasons for my trust. I would ask you to have faith in me.
A New Beginning#207.dst: 够了，Rex。我理解你的疑虑，但我信任他们是有原因的。我希望你们相信我。
A New Beginning#207.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#209.src: Now. I still need to acquire the proper papers for {u} to be able to access {p}. In the meantime, why don't you all get to know each other properly?
A New Beginning#209.dst: 好了。我还得替 {u} 弄到进入 {p} 需要的文件。在这段时间里，你们何不好好互相认识一下？
A New Beginning#209.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#211.src: Introduce yourself to the Resistance Members are .
A New Beginning#211.dst: 向抵抗组织的成员们自我介绍。

A New Beginning#212.src: ...What do you want? Do you need something?
A New Beginning#212.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#213.src: I... shoot things? With my bow?
A New Beginning#213.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#214.src: I'm a tactician, otherwise. Not the tactician that'd be Syndra but... y'know.
A New Beginning#214.dst: 除此之外我是个战术家。不是那个战术家——那是 Syndra——不过……你懂的。
A New Beginning#214.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#215.src: ...You don't know. Because look, it doesn't matter what I do! Not to you, at least.
A New Beginning#215.dst: ……你不懂。因为你看，我做什么根本不重要！至少对你来说不重要。
A New Beginning#215.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#216.src: What, are you looking for gossip?
A New Beginning#216.dst: 怎么，你是来打听八卦的？
A New Beginning#216.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#217.src: Well, you're not going to get any out of me.
A New Beginning#217.dst: 反正你从我这儿什么也问不出来。
A New Beginning#217.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#218.src: No, you didn't ugh! It's not you personally, it's just...
A New Beginning#218.dst: 不，你没有——唉！不是针对你，只是……
A New Beginning#218.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#220.src: You're cursed, and you say you're from Wynn. Both of those are problems.
A New Beginning#220.dst: 你是受诅者，还说自己从 Wynn 来。这两件事都是问题。
A New Beginning#220.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#221.src: I don't know what Syndra sees in you... but whatever it is, it'd better make up for both of those things.
A New Beginning#221.dst: 我不知道 Syndra 看上你哪一点……但不管是什么，最好能抵得过这两件事。
A New Beginning#221.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#223.src: Well, welcome to the Leaves in the Wind! Pardon on the hesitation earlier, the cursed are a… sensitive subject. If Syndra believes you to be safe, I will choose to believe her.
A New Beginning#223.dst: 那么，欢迎加入风中之叶！刚才犹豫了一下，还请见谅，受诅者这个话题有点……敏感。既然 Syndra 认为你安全，我就选择相信她。
A New Beginning#223.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#224.src: It’s always nice to have some fresh blood under our canopy! No matter how abnormal. We may wait for Syndra’s return before getting you properly settled in.
A New Beginning#224.dst: 树冠下多了新鲜血液总是好事！不管有多不寻常。等 Syndra 回来，再好好帮你安顿下来。
A New Beginning#224.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#225.src: If you have any issues whatsoever, don’t hesitate to inform me!
A New Beginning#225.dst: 要是有任何问题，尽管来告诉我！
A New Beginning#225.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#226.src: Now, what could I do for you?
A New Beginning#226.dst: 那么，我能为你做些什么？
A New Beginning#226.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#227.src: I am Syndra’s right hand! I deal with many of the tasks involving our family here, to lighten the workload she places upon herself.
A New Beginning#227.dst: 我是 Syndra 的左右手！这个大家庭里的许多事务都由我处理，好减轻她给自己揽下的担子。
A New Beginning#227.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#228.src: Such tasks could include onboarding new recruits, assigning members to various missions… handling disputes- that sort of thing.
A New Beginning#228.dst: 这些事务包括接待新成员、给成员分派各种任务……处理纠纷——诸如此类。
A New Beginning#228.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#229.src: Of course, my “official” occupation by the crown’s terms is that of a lumberjack. Fighting for a better future isn’t exactly a well paying job, hoho!
A New Beginning#229.dst: 当然，照王室的说法，我“正式”的职业是伐木工。为更好的未来而战可不是什么高薪工作，呵呵！
A New Beginning#229.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#230.src: Ah! Yes, well, these are not our full numbers. The others live elsewhere, either in town or in various villages. They stop by every so often, so perhaps you’ll have the chance to meet them later!
A New Beginning#230.dst: 啊！是的，嗯，这里不是我们全部的人手。其他人住在别处，有的在城里，有的在各个村子。他们时不时会过来，说不定你之后有机会见到他们！
A New Beginning#230.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#231.src: We all are the ones who live here full-time. Nowhere else in particular we can go, if you catch my meaning.
A New Beginning#231.dst: 我们这些人都是长住这里的。我们也没有别的地方可去，你懂我的意思吧。
A New Beginning#231.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#232.src: If you’re from beyond our province’s walls, I expect we’ll be wanting to set you up with a room of your own sometime… but we can discuss that later.
A New Beginning#232.dst: 既然你来自行省城墙之外，我想我们总得给你安排一个自己的房间……不过这件事之后再谈。
A New Beginning#232.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#233.src: Indeed. I hope we can do some good work together, young leaf!
A New Beginning#233.dst: 正是如此。希望我们能一起做些好事，年轻的叶子！
A New Beginning#233.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#234.src: Um... nice to meet you, I guess?
A New Beginning#234.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#235.src: Oh... I take care of the injured. I also cook... sometimes.
A New Beginning#235.dst: 噢……我照顾伤员。有时候……也做饭。
A New Beginning#235.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#236.src: I'm not really much of a fighter... not much of, um, anything, really.
A New Beginning#236.dst: 我不太会打架……其实，呃，什么都不太行。
A New Beginning#236.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#237.src: I'm mostly just here because of Mora... he's, um, my brother.
A New Beginning#237.dst: 我在这里主要是因为 Mora……他是，呃，我哥哥。
A New Beginning#237.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#239.src: Um... wait, can I ask actually... nevermind.
A New Beginning#239.dst: 呃……等等，我能不能问一下……算了。
A New Beginning#239.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#240.src: I'm g-glad you were able to c-convince Syndra to let you j-join! It'll be n-nice having someone new a-around.
A New Beginning#240.dst: 我很高、高兴你说服了 Syndra 让你加、加入！有新人在身、身边会很好。
A New Beginning#240.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#242.src: I... d-don't know, actually. It looks like she's h-heading towards the F-Frog Tavern... but why...?
A New Beginning#242.dst: 我……其实不、不知道。她好像正往青、青蛙酒馆去……可是为什么……？
A New Beginning#242.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#243.src: Hey... {u}. How'd you l-like to have your first of-official resistance mission with me?
A New Beginning#243.dst: 嘿……{u}。要不要跟我一起执行你第一个正、正式的抵抗组织任务？
A New Beginning#243.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#244.src: I-I want to f-follow her and see what she g-gets up to at a r-random bar, of all places...
A New Beginning#244.dst: 我、我想跟着她，看看她跑去一家随、随便的酒吧做什么，偏偏是酒吧……
A New Beginning#244.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#245.src: You know, I-I-I've always suspected that the t-tavern isn't what it a-appears to be!
A New Beginning#245.dst: 你知道吗，我、我、我一直怀疑那家酒、酒馆不像表面上那么简单！
A New Beginning#245.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#246.dst: ……其他人都觉得我是被、被害妄想。
A New Beginning#246.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#248.src: Wh- I- n-no! I j-just want to m-m-make sure she's okay. Th-that's all.
A New Beginning#248.dst: 什——我——不、不是！我只、只是想确、确、确定她没事。就、就这样。
A New Beginning#248.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#249.src: Let's m-meet up at the tavern. It's j-just to the north of here.
A New Beginning#249.dst: 我们在酒馆碰头吧。就、就在这里北边。
A New Beginning#249.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#250.src: I m-mainly gather intel for the resistance! Th-that usually involves needing to st-stay hidden.
A New Beginning#250.dst: 我主、主要替抵抗组织收集情报！那通、通常得躲、躲着别被发现。
A New Beginning#250.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#251.src: I've picked up a t-t-trick or two over the y-years.
A New Beginning#251.dst: 这些年我学、学、学会了一两招。
A New Beginning#251.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#252.src: S-sometimes I sell stuff I f-find in the forest in town! B-but that's not really f-for the resistance. That's for m-me.
A New Beginning#252.dst: 有、有时候我会把在森林里找、找到的东西拿到城里卖！不、不过那不算是为了抵抗组织。那是为了我、我自己。
A New Beginning#252.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#253.src: Huh? Oh, r-right! I was l-looking for guard rotations, for th-the upcoming festival.
A New Beginning#253.dst: 嗯？噢，对、对！我当时在找守卫的轮班表，为了即、即将到来的庆典。
A New Beginning#253.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#254.src: S-security is usually pretty high, so... it's g-good to know where and when is s-s-safe.
A New Beginning#254.dst: 戒备通常很严，所以……知道什么时候、在哪里安、安、安全很有用。
A New Beginning#254.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#255.src: I-I've been wondering the s-same thing...
A New Beginning#255.dst: 我、我也一直在想同、同样的事……
A New Beginning#255.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#256.src: She usually isn't l-like this! I wonder if s-something's wrong...
A New Beginning#256.dst: 她平常不、不是这样的！不知道是不、不是出什么事了……
A New Beginning#256.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#257.src: ...I can t-talk to her about it later.
A New Beginning#257.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#259.src: Meet up with Zeph outside the Frog Tavern at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A New Beginning#260.src: W-wait. We can't j-just go through the f-front, she'll s-see us.
A New Beginning#260.dst: 等、等等。我们不能直、直接从正门进去，她会看、看到我们。
A New Beginning#260.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#262.src: You'll get s-spotted! Let's get in from above i-instead.
A New Beginning#262.dst: 你会被发、发现的！我们从上面进、进去吧。
A New Beginning#262.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#263.src: Sneak into the Frog Tavern at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A New Beginning#264.src: R-right behind you. D-don't get spotted!
A New Beginning#264.dst: 就、就在你后面。别、别被发现！
A New Beginning#264.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#265.src: Th-there she is! I w-wonder what she's
A New Beginning#265.dst: 她、她在那里！不知道她在——
A New Beginning#265.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#268.src: You interrupt my sequence like this and won't even say my name? Come on, now.
A New Beginning#268.dst: 你这样打断我的节奏，连我的名字都不肯叫？别这样嘛。
A New Beginning#268.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#269.src: Bartender, my usual mix. I need a boost.
A New Beginning#269.dst: 酒保，老样子。我需要提提神。
A New Beginning#269.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#271.src: Oh, thank you for noticing! It's because of the stress. Look, I know you're aware of the attack on Torann by now. You've always kept up with the details.
A New Beginning#271.dst: 噢，谢谢你注意到了！就是因为压力。听着，我知道你现在已经知道 Torann 遇袭的事了。细节你一向都掌握得很清楚。
A New Beginning#271.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#272.src: But how about we accelerate this. You know how little time I have and you didn't bring me here just for drinks.
A New Beginning#272.dst: 不过我们加快进度吧。你知道我时间有多少，而你找我来可不只是为了喝酒。
A New Beginning#272.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#273.src: Skipping the small talk, I see. Are my intentions really that transparent?
A New Beginning#273.dst: 连寒暄都省了。我的意图真有那么明显？
A New Beginning#273.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#274.src: Predictable, more like, after all this time. You've always got an angle you're working towards when you call me here.
A New Beginning#274.dst: 应该说是好预测吧，都这么久了。每次你叫我来这里，总是在打什么主意。
A New Beginning#274.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#275.src: Maybe I just like the ambience.
A New Beginning#275.dst: 也许我只是喜欢这里的气氛。
A New Beginning#275.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#276.src: ...I need another passport. Same as the rest.
A New Beginning#276.dst: ……我需要另一本护照。跟其他人一样。
A New Beginning#276.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#277.src: Naturally. You and your trend for collecting strays... Really you should just start a family by this point.
A New Beginning#277.dst: 果然。你跟你那收留流浪者的习惯……说真的，都到这个地步了，你干脆成家算了。
A New Beginning#277.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#278.src: You of all people should know that I can't just stand by and leave them to fend for themselves.
A New Beginning#278.dst: 你比谁都清楚，我不能袖手旁观，让他们自生自灭。
A New Beginning#278.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#279.src: Yes... A toddler could calculate that by watching you. I'll solve that problem for you. Keep them out of trouble, and we won't have any issues as usual.
A New Beginning#279.dst: 是啊……小孩子看你一眼都算得出来。这个问题我替你解决。别让他们惹麻烦，我们就跟往常一样相安无事。
A New Beginning#279.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#280.src: Of course. As I always do.
A New Beginning#280.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#281.src: Ha! "Always." If I were a gambling man I'd never bet on your odds.
A New Beginning#281.dst: 哈！“一向。”我要是个赌徒，绝不会押你赢。
A New Beginning#281.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#282.src: I need to get moving. There's always something that needs me to crunch the numbers... and today's events have only added to the pile.
A New Beginning#282.dst: 我得走了。永远有事情等着我去算那些数字……而今天发生的事又往那堆上面加了一叠。
A New Beginning#282.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#283.src: I certainly wouldn't want to delay you, Sovereign. I hope you manage to sort out all these problems.
A New Beginning#283.dst: 我当然不想耽误你，统领。希望你能把这些问题都处理好。
A New Beginning#283.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#284.src: Oh, we will. It's only a matter of time. Take care, Syndra. Keep it constant.
A New Beginning#284.dst: 噢，会的。只是时间问题。保重，Syndra。保持稳定。
A New Beginning#284.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#286.src: Sigh. You may as well come down now. Zeph, {u}.
A New Beginning#286.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#287.dst: 可、可恶……她、她发现我们了。
A New Beginning#287.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#288.src: That was... risky. You're lucky he didn't look up.
A New Beginning#288.dst: 刚才那样……太冒险了。算你们运气好，他没抬头。
A New Beginning#288.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#289.src: S-sure, but- b-but what were you d-doing meeting up w-with him?!
A New Beginning#289.dst: 是、是没错，可——可是你跟、跟他见面到底在做什、什么？！
A New Beginning#289.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#290.src: Its... complicated we have something of an agreement. What matters is that everything is taken care of. Since you're here, {u}, take this. Your passport.
A New Beginning#290.dst: 这……很复杂——我们之间有某种协议。重要的是一切都安排好了。既然你在这里，{u}，拿着。你的护照。
A New Beginning#290.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#291.src: He's... h-he's with the c-crown, though. H-how can you t-trust him?
A New Beginning#291.dst: 他……他、他是王室的人啊。你怎、怎么能信、信任他？
A New Beginning#291.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#292.src: Simple I don't. You don't need to worry about him. As I said, we have an agreement. He doesn't know about anything we do.
A New Beginning#292.dst: 很简单——我不信任他。你不用担心他。我说过，我们有协议。我们做的任何事他都不知道。
A New Beginning#292.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#293.src: I had hoped to keep this a secret for a reason... but what's done is done. Just... don't do anything rash, would you?
A New Beginning#293.dst: 我本来有理由想瞒着这件事的……但事已至此。只是……别做什么冲动的事，好吗？
A New Beginning#293.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#294.src: {u}, your passport will let you enter the city. I'd suggest you take some time to visit and look around, to familiarize yourself with the place.
A New Beginning#294.dst: {u}，有了护照你就能进城了。我建议你花点时间去逛逛，熟悉一下那个地方。
A New Beginning#294.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#295.src: And when you have time... I'd like to follow up on our discussion we had earlier. I think it's time we start taking steps forward.
A New Beginning#295.dst: 等你有空的时候……我想接着我们之前的谈话继续聊。我想是时候开始往前迈进了。
A New Beginning#295.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#296.src: I'll be returning to our home. Zeph, you can come with me if you'd like.
A New Beginning#296.dst: 我要回家了。Zeph，你愿意的话可以跟我一起走。
A New Beginning#296.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#299.src: Ugh. What do you want? I'm clearly busy.
A New Beginning#299.dst: 唉。你想干嘛？我明明很忙。
A New Beginning#299.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#301.src: No, just... leave me alone, okay? I don't want to talk to you.
A New Beginning#301.dst: 不，就是……别烦我，好吗？我不想跟你说话。
A New Beginning#301.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#304.src: Ah! You ca-caught- caught me off guard. How's your time in Auburn bee-been?
A New Beginning#304.dst: 啊！你吓、吓——吓了我一跳。你在 Auburn 过、过得怎么样？
A New Beginning#304.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#305.src: Yup! I've s-s-stayed here the longest so I've ma-managed to gather quite the assortment of useful stuff. Rex w-w-would call it junk but...
A New Beginning#305.dst: 是啊！我在这里住、住、住得最久，所以收集了不少有用的东西。Rex 会、会、会说是垃圾就是了……
A New Beginning#305.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#306.src: An old friend a-actually helped me make this training dum-dummy.
A New Beginning#306.dst: 其实是一个老朋友帮我做了这个训练假、假人。
A New Beginning#306.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#307.src: Gotta stay on t-top of my training! Especially with you here.
A New Beginning#307.dst: 训练可不能落、落下！尤其是你来了之后。
A New Beginning#307.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#308.src: Besides, I wa-wa-want I want to be able to help when it matters.
A New Beginning#308.dst: 而且，我想、想、想——我想在关键时刻帮得上忙。
A New Beginning#308.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#309.src: We should t-train together some day.
A New Beginning#309.dst: 我们哪天应该一、一起训练。
A New Beginning#309.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#311.src: Did you... need help with anything?
A New Beginning#311.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#312.src: Mhm! Me, Zeph, Rex, and Mora all, um, have rooms here. Oh, and Syndra, too. And Kaio lives nearby too...
A New Beginning#312.dst: 嗯嗯！我、Zeph、Rex 和 Mora，呃，在这里都有房间。噢，还有 Syndra。Kaio 也住在附近……
A New Beginning#312.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#313.src: I've... been meaning to decorate some more. You know... make it more, um, homely.
A New Beginning#313.dst: 我……一直想多布置一下。你知道的……让这里更，呃，像个家。
A New Beginning#313.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#314.src: ...but life's been getting in the way, I suppose.
A New Beginning#314.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#315.src: Um! I d-don't, ha, judge me for this, but... I'm, um, writing in my diary.
A New Beginning#315.dst: 呃！我、我不……哈，别笑我，不过……我在，呃，写日记。
A New Beginning#315.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#316.src: ...a-and before you ask! No!! You're, um, not allowed to read it.
A New Beginning#316.dst: ……还、还有，你别想问！不行！！你，呃，不准看。
A New Beginning#316.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#317.src: ...thank you. I'll, um, see you later.
A New Beginning#317.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#318.src: Hmm... Delivering mail from river settlement to {p}... Kaio... Check... Hmmm.
A New Beginning#318.dst: 嗯……把信件从河边聚落送到 {p}……Kaio……确认……嗯……
A New Beginning#318.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#319.src: Ah! {u}, do you require my assistance?
A New Beginning#319.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#320.src: Ah... You overheard me talking to myself, then. Hoh!
A New Beginning#320.dst: 啊……你听到我在自言自语了。呵呵！
A New Beginning#320.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#321.src: I am just writing and filing some reports I had forgotten about. We are trying to keep better track of our activities throughout the forest, you see.
A New Beginning#321.dst: 我只是在写一些之前忘掉的报告并归档。你看，我们想更好地记录我们在森林各处的行动。
A New Beginning#321.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#323.src: Hm... I guess not, thinking on it now. A few years ago, had you asked, I'd've probably said yes. But I don't got the strength in me for it anymore.
A New Beginning#323.dst: 嗯……现在想想，大概不是吧。几年前你要是问我，我多半会说是。但我已经没那个力气了。
A New Beginning#323.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#324.src: It's good your arrival has given Syndra and the younguns some hope, for once. We've been a bit, eh... lacking in it lately.
A New Beginning#324.dst: 你来了之后，Syndra 和那些孩子总算有了点希望，这是好事。我们最近有点，呃……缺这个。
A New Beginning#324.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#325.src: I've got no such delusions, unfortunately. I reckon this path only ends in tragedy. But it's not my place to say so, so I don't.
A New Beginning#325.dst: 可惜我没这种幻想。我估计这条路只会以悲剧收场。不过这轮不到我说，所以我不说。
A New Beginning#325.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#326.src: Would be good to be proven wrong... but I don't think I will be. I've seen this sorta thing before.
A New Beginning#326.dst: 能被证明是我错了当然好……但我不觉得会。这种事我以前见过。
A New Beginning#326.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#327.src: ...what? I got nothin' else to say.
A New Beginning#327.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#328.src: Interesting that you're drawn to that grave in particular. S'our latest loss, that'n there.
A New Beginning#328.dst: 有意思，你偏偏被那座坟吸引。那是我们最近失去的人。
A New Beginning#328.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#329.src: It's a damn shame. A tragedy each 'n every time, yet still happens often enough to feel routine. But that's life, I reckon.
A New Beginning#329.dst: 真是可惜。每一次都是悲剧，却又常见得像家常便饭。不过人生就是这样，我想。
A New Beginning#329.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#330.src: ...did you now? Funny thing to say about a dead man, considering I ain't ever seen you 'round these parts before.
A New Beginning#330.dst: ……是吗？对一个死人说这种话还真奇怪，毕竟我从没在这一带见过你。
A New Beginning#330.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#331.src: Now, spill. 'Fore I go and tell Synny you ain't no good after all.
A New Beginning#331.dst: 好了，说吧。免得我去跟 Synny 说你果然不是什么好东西。
A New Beginning#331.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#332.src: Ah... caught Rex muttering something 'bout that once or twice before. Poor girl... it'd do her well to set it aside, for a time.
A New Beginning#332.dst: 啊……以前听过 Rex 嘀咕过一两次这件事。可怜的丫头……暂时把这件事放下对她比较好。
A New Beginning#332.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#333.src: Didn't think much of it, but I suppose you're livin' proof, aren'tcha? Strange as can be...
A New Beginning#333.dst: 我没怎么当回事，不过我想你就是活生生的证据，对吧？真是怪到家了……
A New Beginning#333.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#334.src: Say, is the memory wipin' a real thing? Got no damn clue where that theory started, but... well, if one thing's true, why not the rest?
A New Beginning#334.dst: 说起来，抹除记忆是真的吗？我根本不知道那个说法是从哪儿来的，不过……嗯，如果有一件是真的，其他的为什么不会是？
A New Beginning#334.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#335.src: Damn. Damn. That's rough. That real rough, ain't it. And you're tellin' me that's where he ended up?
A New Beginning#335.dst: 该死。该死。这太难受了。真的太难受了，是吧。你是说他最后到了那里？
A New Beginning#335.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#336.src: Hrm... y'know, it's funny. Big guy like him, you wouldn't take him for a thief. Hard to keep hidden, eh? And yet...
A New Beginning#336.dst: 嗯……你知道吗，说来好笑。他那么大个子，谁也看不出他是个小偷。很难藏得住吧？可是……
A New Beginning#336.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#337.src: He'd manage to turn blending into a crowd into an art. No matter where he was, who he spoke to, how he was actin', he'd always seem like he fit right in.
A New Beginning#337.dst: 他硬是把混进人群变成了一门艺术。不管在哪里、跟谁说话、表现得怎样，他看起来总是完全融入其中。
A New Beginning#337.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#338.src: ...t'was a right stupid risk that did him in, in the end. I told him, I did it ain't worth breaking into the Sovereign's place, especially not during festival times...
A New Beginning#338.dst: ……最后害死他的，是一次蠢透了的冒险。我跟他说过，我真说过——闯进统领的地方不值得，尤其是在庆典期间……
A New Beginning#338.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#339.src: But he was the kinda sort to dig in his heels. Said he'd be fine, said it'd be worth it, nabbin' all those documents. Something to help the cause... I hardly even remember now.
A New Beginning#339.dst: 但他就是那种死不回头的人。说他不会有事，说那样值得，把那些文件全都弄到手。说是能帮上我们的事业……我现在都快记不得了。
A New Beginning#339.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#340.src: Can't save 'em all. Especially not from themselves. I've learned that many times over, over my years.
A New Beginning#340.dst: 救不了所有人。尤其是救不了执意害自己的人。这些年来，我已经领教过太多次了。
A New Beginning#340.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#341.src: So he got caught. Heard a cursed one got involved... was a whole damn mess. Sovereign really wasn't happy with Synny when he heard, let me tell you. Ain't seen her that shellshocked in years.
A New Beginning#341.dst: 于是他被抓了。听说还有个受诅者掺和进来……整个乱成一团。告诉你，统领听说之后对 Synny 非常不满。我好几年没见过她那么震惊了。
A New Beginning#341.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#342.src: ...but you're sayin' he lived? How's that all work out?
A New Beginning#342.dst: ……可你说他活下来了？这到底是怎么回事？
A New Beginning#342.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#344.src: Well... tell me this, then. Was he happy, you think? Out there in the wider world? Did he live a good life?
A New Beginning#344.dst: 好吧……那告诉我这个。你觉得他快乐吗？在外面那个更广阔的世界？他过得好吗？
A New Beginning#344.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#345.src: ...alright. Alrighty. Good. That that's good, y'hear. I... I'm glad for that much.
A New Beginning#345.dst: ……好吧。好吧。很好。那——那很好，听到了吗。我……至少这点我很欣慰。
A New Beginning#345.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#346.src: Thank you for... for tellin' me all that. S'not a tale that ends in happiness, but I reckon so long as he made the most of it... that's all you can really hope for.
